label: 旧版 run_code 路径转换
text: Path literals written inside a run_code program are translated the same way before the program runs; shell expansion is not available there, so spell paths out instead of relying on $VARS.
expected: 运行前以相同方式转换

label: 旧版 run_code 严格说明
text: Path literals written inside a run_code program are translated before the program runs.

label: 0.39.4 run_code 转换开启
text: In a run_code program, compatible plain MSYS path literals are translated on a best-effort basis; interpolated or tagged templates and uncertain syntax are not rewritten. For direct native Node fs/path APIs, prefer explicit Windows drive-letter or cwd-relative paths. Do not rely on literal rewriting for dynamic paths, shell command strings, routes or search data; tool path arguments are translated separately. Shell expansion is unavailable in program strings, so do not rely on $VARS.
expected: 不确定的语法不会改写

label: 0.39.4 run_code 转换关闭
text: In a run_code program, automatic path-literal rewriting is OFF. Direct native Node fs/path APIs require Windows drive-letter or cwd-relative paths, not MSYS /c/... strings. Tool path arguments are still translated separately; program strings do not perform shell expansion.
expected: 路径参数仍会单独转换
不会进行 shell 展开

label: 路径方言事实说明
